ld.quote: If Vendor fails to complete a milestone by the date specified in the SOW due to causes attributable to Vendor, Lakeshore may assess liquidated damages of one-half percent (0.5%) of the affected Milestone Fee per week of delay, up to a maximum of five percent (5%) of that Milestone Fee.

liability.capText: The parties' aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under the applicable SOW in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality, indemnification obligations, or gross negligence or willful misconduct.
liability.quote: EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THE APPLICABLE SOW IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.

annexes.name: Rate Card
annexes.quote: Rates are inclusive of all overheads. Offshore and onshore personnel are charged at the same rates. Rates apply to change orders and any future SOWs under this Agreement.

annexes.name: SOW-1: Retail Analytics Modernization (Summary)
annexes.quote: The first SOW ('**SOW-1**') is attached as Exhibit B and covers: (a) migration of Lakeshore's legacy on-premises SQL Server data warehouse to a cloud lakehouse; (b) build of automated ingestion pipelines for point-of-sale, loyalty, inventory and e-commerce order data from all stores; (c) a certified semantic layer for sales, margin, shrink and promotions; and (d) Power BI dashboards for store operations, category management and executive leadership.

annexes.name: Information Security Requirements
annexes.quote: Vendor shall comply with Lakeshore's Information Security Requirements (Exhibit C) and applicable privacy laws, including the Illinois Personal Information Protection Act.
